summary: Barrick Mining Corp filed a 6-K reporting Q1 2026 results including an update on the North American Barrick IPO, which is a spin-off transaction. The registrant is the issuer. The IPO targets completion by year-end 2026. No specific terms, premiums, or advisors are disclosed. Mechanically, this is a spin-off of Barrick's North American operations into a separate publicly traded entity. The filing also announces a $3.0 billion share buyback program and a $0.175 per share quarterly dividend. Watch for further details on the spin-off structure, shareholder approval, and regulatory timelines.
